content:
SELECTED_INDEX: 3
CONFIDENCE: 0.27
EXPLANATION: The dominant very strong band at 2234 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of a ν(C≡N) stretch; among the candidates this is present only in 1, 3 and 6.  
The pair of strong bands at 1654 cm⁻¹ and 1634 cm⁻¹ match an amide-I carbonyl ν(C=O) that typically appears near 1650 cm⁻¹, not the higher-frequency aldehyde (~1720 cm⁻¹, candidate 1) or ester (~1730 cm⁻¹, candidate 6).  
Candidate 3 contains both an amide carbonyl and a nitrile (C=C=CCNC(=O)CSCC#N), so it explains simultaneously the 2234 cm⁻¹ (nitrile) and the 1654/1634 cm⁻¹ (amide) peaks.  
Additional medium bands at 1349, 1272, 1125 and the C–S region peaks at 885/857 cm⁻¹ are consistent with CH bending, C–N stretching and C–S vibrations expected for the thioether in candidate 3.  
Therefore candidate 3 provides the best overall match to the experimental Raman pattern.
